was: BLM campground ~8 mi NW of Kanab near Coral Pink Sand Dunes at ~6,300 ft; 35 sites shaded by ponderosa pines with vault toilets, fire rings, picnic tables, tent pads and a gravel access road, no water/hookups. Sites accommodate trailers up to 24 ft (rigs over 24 ft not permitted due to short turnarounds). Open year-round, first-come, first-served. --Claude

Self-contained only -- no facilities. 14-day limit, first-come, first-served. Short 'Belly of the Dragon' walk nearby. --Claude

No reservations, no facilities, pack-in/pack-out, no campfires, 14-day limit. Managed by the Monticello Field Office. --Claude

Some loops reservable online, others first-come, first-served. NOTE: currently CLOSED for the 2026 season for rehabilitation after the June 2025 Forsyth Fire and subsequent flooding -- verify reopening before visiting. --Claude

was: USFS Dixie NF, west shore of Tropic Reservoir at ~8000 ft, ~9 mi W of Bryce Canyon NP via a partly paved, well-maintained gravel road (good RV access). Tent/RV sites + 2 group sites; flush toilets, drinking water and dump station in peak season. Individual sites first-come, first-served; group sites reservable on recreation.gov. --Claude

was: Dixie NF campground in Red Canyon on Scenic Byway UT-12, ~10 mi W of Bryce; 37 sites among ponderosa, RVs to 45 ft, dump station ($10), no hookups. First-come, first-served (not on recreation.gov). --Claude

was: USFS Manti-La Sal NF (Monticello RD), ~12 mi NW of Blanding at the foot of the Abajo Mtns, elev ~7,800 ft. 21 single sites plus 2 group areas; vault toilets, seasonal drinking water, no hookups. Reservable on Recreation.gov (single sites also open FCFS when unbooked). Access is paved/graveled forest road. --Claude

Tight steep entrance and creek dip: RVs over 25 ft not recommended (23-ft rig fits but maneuvering is snug). Trailhead for Lower Calf Creek Falls. --Claude

was: BLM Henry Mountains, at the southern tip of the range ~6,300 ft, reached via ~5 mi of graded gravel road off SR-276 (passable to a normal vehicle when dry; can rut when wet). 12 individual sites plus 1 group site; picnic tables, fire rings, vault toilets, nature trail, potable water intermittent (bring your own). First-come first-served, no hookups. --Claude

Vault toilets, no hookups. Access via FR 149; the last ~3.4 mi are steep single-lane with switchbacks and turnouts -- drivable by a nimble 23-ft rig in dry weather but not big trailers. Trout fishing, trailheads to backcountry lakes. --Claude

BLM has approved developing it into a ~45-site campground (construction anticipated 2026). --Claude
